lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Two cities, two lies, one rock.|The rock, at least, is honest.
lines.text: Two cities, two lies, one rock. The rock, at least, is honest.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: They say Adamarch staged it. I bled on that|sand, Ice-king. I would like to know for whom.
lines.text: They say Adamarch staged it. I bled on that sand, Ice-king. I would like to know for whom.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: So would I. Malrik sailed home before|the blood was dry. That is not mourning.
lines.text: So would I. Malrik sailed home before the blood was dry. That is not mourning.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The bettors fled with their strongboxes and|dropped half of them. Coin always runs downhill.
lines.text: The bettors fled with their strongboxes and dropped half of them. Coin always runs downhill.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Back again, Torvald? You're the slowest|man I know, and you're still everywhere.
lines.text: Back again, Torvald? You're the slowest man I know, and you're still everywhere.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The Citadel stands. Aldra.|I would rather not do this one alone.
lines.text: The Citadel stands. Aldra. I would rather not do this one alone.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: You never do anything alone,|my lord. You only think you do.
lines.text: You never do anything alone, my lord. You only think you do.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: The barricade is down. Walls should|know when to fall. Ours never did.
lines.text: The barricade is down. Walls should know when to fall. Ours never did.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: You hold my rock. Look under the|cloths. The dead are poor liars.
lines.text: You hold my rock. Look under the cloths. The dead are poor liars.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Aurivane's cloaks, on knives forged in the dark.|The edges drink the light. Shadow steel.
lines.text: Aurivane's cloaks, on knives forged in the dark. The edges drink the light. Shadow steel.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The boat my rune saw left violet smoke.|Gold cloaks do not row from the north.
lines.text: The boat my rune saw left violet smoke. Gold cloaks do not row from the north.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The bettors' ledger. Someone wagered against|both cities, on the same night, before the duel.
lines.text: The bettors' ledger. Someone wagered against both cities, on the same night, before the duel.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: A man who bets on the war, not the winner.|I know only one with that much patience.
lines.text: A man who bets on the war, not the winner. I know only one with that much patience.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: Don't hurt me! I only read the names! I saw|the boat, a black boat, from the north side!
lines.text: Don't hurt me! I only read the names! I saw the boat, a black boat, from the north side!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Easy. Who stepped out of it?
lines.text: Easy. Who stepped out of it?

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: A woman in a white mask. She never said a word.|The knives followed her like ducklings.
lines.text: A woman in a white mask. She never said a word. The knives followed her like ducklings.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: A white mask. Then I know the knife,|and I know the hand that throws it.
lines.text: A white mask. Then I know the knife, and I know the hand that throws it.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: You want the truth told on my sand, Ice-king? Then by the old rule. First blood, and no further.
lines.text: You want the truth told on my sand, Ice-king? Then by the old rule. First blood, and no further.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Well struck. Twice now an Adamarch guest has|cut me. I am starting to take it personally.
lines.text: Well struck. Twice now an Adamarch guest has cut me. I am starting to take it personally.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: First blood to the Sun. Now say your|truth, Ice-king, and I will listen.
lines.text: First blood to the Sun. Now say your truth, Ice-king, and I will listen.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: Neither bleeds! By the law,|it is a draw, and the sand is quiet!
lines.text: Neither bleeds! By the law, it is a draw, and the sand is quiet!

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Hush now, Sunblade.|The war only needs one more death.
lines.text: Hush now, Sunblade. The war only needs one more death.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Behind you, Dacian! The knives again!
lines.text: Behind you, Dacian! The knives again!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I know those knives. I've had them at|my throat. Hush! I owe you a night!
lines.text: I know those knives. I've had them at my throat. Hush! I owe you a night!

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: There is always another night, Ice-king.|Ask your friend how he spends his.
lines.text: There is always another night, Ice-king. Ask your friend how he spends his.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Those were never ours.|You knew before you came to the sand.
lines.text: Those were never ours. You knew before you came to the sand.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Mother Hush. I have stood beside this mask|in Malrik's camp. They were my ally's knives.
lines.text: Mother Hush. I have stood beside this mask in Malrik's camp. They were my ally's knives.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Then your ally broke a truce that held|for a hundred and thirty years. For what?
lines.text: Then your ally broke a truce that held for a hundred and thirty years. For what?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: For a war that does not end. Wars are good|for business, and better for that stone.
lines.text: For a war that does not end. Wars are good for business, and better for that stone.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: First blood, and no further.|The cities forgot. Let us see if you remember.
lines.text: First blood, and no further. The cities forgot. Let us see if you remember.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Bettors' gold. It spends the same as honest|gold, which is the whole trouble with gold.
lines.text: Bettors' gold. It spends the same as honest gold, which is the whole trouble with gold.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: The Sunblade is down. Every bell in|both cities will ring for war now.
lines.text: The Sunblade is down. Every bell in both cities will ring for war now.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Too late. I always arrive... too late.
lines.text: Too late. I always arrive... too late.
